name: Manifold Markets
description: Free play-money prediction market platform where users create and trade on questions about any topic. Aggregates collective intelligence through market price discovery mechanisms. Used for research on prediction market dynamics and information aggregation.
evaluation_method: Market price as probability, Brier score on resolution
typical_sota_score: Brier ≈ 0.05–0.15 for top forecasters (lower is better); varies widely by question and horizon
notes: Free play-money platform accessible without financial commitment. Open to any question type. Used in academic research on prediction market mechanisms.
